method_note_realized_trade_proxy: Trade records carry entry_idx/entry_timestamp/direction/pnl (c948bcd) but NOT zone-level metadata (broken_at/valid_from/zone id) -- adding that would require editing the engine, which this read-only receipt task forbids. Consequently this receipt uses a REALIZED-TRADE proximity heuristic (greedy nearest-neighbor pairing, same symbol+direction, within PAIR_WINDOW_BARS=40 bars -- covers breaker zone_age_limit=30 and unicorn max_zone_age=20 plus buffer) to link a batch-only 'removed' trade to a nearby streaming-only trade, mirroring the ratified investigation's bar-39-removed/bar-43-freed pattern (59dbc2a commit message). This is NOT the ratified acceptance-gate's 4-predicate raw-candidate closed taxonomy (which needs internal per-bar signal state discarded after the backtest completes) -- it is a coarser, fully-declared proxy adequate for a materiality receipt that gates nothing. Classes (b) occupancy-freed and (c) timing-shifted are NOT separable from realized trades alone and are reported as one merged 'paired' bucket. Streaming-only trades with NO nearby batch-only-removed partner are reported separately as 'unexplained_stream_only' -- NOT claimed clean, NOT claimed a (d)-class bug either; the full predicate check would be needed to resolve them and was out of scope for this receipt. Observed pairing bar-distance: n=46, median=4.0, min=2, max=36 bars (median 4 matches the ratified bar-39/bar-43 example exactly).

aggregate.interpretation: Aggregate peeked-window win rate 41.7% (n=84) vs clean/common win rate 32.8% (n=3169) -- delta +8.9pp. Per the locked pre-read: a HIGHER peeked win rate would annotate historical equity as another 'optimistic' bias (alongside Defect 4); a FLAT/negative delta means the look-ahead was real but non-exploitative on this corpus. Result here is POSITIVE (aggregate) but NOT UNIFORM across pairs -- 3 of 6 pairs (breaker_MCL, unicorn_MCL, unicorn_MES) show NEGATIVE deltas. This is a real, mixed-sign result on real data, reported as measured -- not smoothed into a single directional claim.
